description: Supersedes disc-0003, which stated the bundle-fact attributes as five and was falsified by the rc.6 amendment. The single discovery file is a conformant RFC 9264 link set: `linkset` is the sole top-level member, integrity rides on the links as RFC 9530 `digest` and `agsc-*` extension target attributes whose values are ALWAYS arrays of strings, bundle facts live only on the anchor's `describedby` link, and relation names are either IANA-registered short names or `.../rel#<name>` extension URIs. Derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine. The SIX bundle-fact attributes are the five AGSC-06-08 has carried since rc.2 — `agsc-bundle-hash`, `agsc-counts`, `agsc-generated-at`, `agsc-spec-version` and `digest` — plus `agsc-bundle-version`, added at rc.6 under owner decision D113 because the bundle hash says whether two nodes hold the same content and never what the publisher calls that content. They are listed in the JSON member-name order of AGSC-04-05, which is the order the canonical bytes carry, so `agsc-bundle-version` falls between `agsc-bundle-hash` and `agsc-counts` (`h` before `v`, and `agsc-bundle-` is a common prefix) and `digest` last (`d` after `a`). AGSC-06-08a makes every one of them REQUIRED at Level 2 and above, so a Level-2 document that omits one is not conforming and the checker of a conforming engine says so with no finding left over. The ledger link carries two attributes and no bundle fact: `agsc-ledger-head` and `digest` (AGSC-06-08, AGSC-06-11). The four forbidden names are the bare short names a reader might expect and RFC 8288 §2.1.1 does not admit: an extension relation is a URI, so `knowledge`, `ontology`, `graph` and `skills` never appear unprefixed.
note: added 2026-09-22 at rc.6 (RC6-C) as the successor of disc-0003; expected values derived by hand from the rule text; unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.6 tag
